T_k: The correction adds a mean-centred, fast-saturating even term in x4 (about -0.23 at x4 = 0 rising to about +0.32 once |x4| > 1.3) that a linear base model cannot represent, plus a saturating x2*x5 interaction that raises the prediction when x2 and x5 share a sign and lowers it when they differ. Linear x1 and x3 effects are assumed to be captured by the base model already, so they are left out, and the total is clipped for stability.
